newsitem.title: GERMANY: Degussa optimistic for year after strong Q1.
newsitem.headline: Degussa optimistic for year after strong Q1.

text.p: FRANKFURT, Feb 4 (Reuter ) - German chemicals and metals group Degussa AG said on Tuesday it expected the positive trend seen in the first quarter to continue through the rest of the year, barring any global economic downturn.

"If there is no unforeseen worsening in the global economic climate, then we expect to see the positive trend continue," the group said in a statement, echoing remarks made by management board chairman Uwe-Ernst Bufe two weeks ago.
Degussa, benefitting from a major restructuring and improved economic conditions, reported first quarter pre-tax profit climbed 20 percent to 115 million marks.
Degussa optimistic about year after strong Q1
The group also said sales climbed 16 percent to 3.46 billion marks with the precious metal and bank unit posting the strongest single sales increase and with foreign sales outpacing domestic sales.

Chemical product sales climbed 8 percent to 952 million marks, health and nutrition sales rose 10 percent to 726 million marks and precious metals and bank sales climbed by 25 percent to 1.78 billion marks.
The group's business year ends September 30.
Degussa's health group Asta Medica however suffered under sluggish domestic business conditions which led to lower profits compared with year-ago levels. The group did not give specific figures.
Degussa shares climbed half a percent, rising to 702 marks on the news, which had been sketched out in broad terms at a news conference two weeks ago.
